scope: Read-only staged implementation review. No database/HTTP traffic or tests run. Hashes are observed snapshots, not final approval.

findings.problem: A transient duplicate close failure in check_locked escapes as OSError and is classified by ParserGate.validate as parserFailure while the image remains ready. Error-path close inside _checked_duplicate can also throw before state is marked failed. A failed close leaves cleanup/ownership uncertain and can permit subsequent admissions and repeated duplicate creation, contrary to fail-closed infrastructure handling and the one-transient bound.
findings.required_fix: Treat transient close/cleanup failure as infrastructureFailure, mark lifecycle failed and cleanup incomplete before propagating, prevent subsequent admissions, and test both normal and error-path injected close failures without unsafe numeric-fd retry.

limitations: The author is still changing the implementation. This report is not a final approval of any subsequent bytes.
Runtime execution, 56-case plan, existing SQL regression and formal correspondence remain separate evidence.
